site.title: The Forge — Keycap Studios
site.description: The Forge by Keycap Studios: a Windows creator suite for video editing, music, clipping, thumbnails and multistreaming.

hero.lead: The Forge is a Windows creator suite: edit videos, make music, cut clips, design thumbnails and stream everywhere at once, all from one hub.

appsSection.title: The apps
appsSection.subtitle: One hub, a growing toolkit. Start with the free editor and add what you need.

apps.name: ForgeCut
apps.text: The core video editor. Fast timeline editing, with optional AI Edit to rough-cut your footage for you.

apps.name: ForgeCast
apps.text: Record and multistream to YouTube (landscape and vertical), Twitch, TikTok and Kick at the same time.

apps.name: Fluxa Studio
apps.text: A music workstation for intros, beds and soundtracks without leaving your workflow.

apps.name: ForgeClip
apps.text: Turn long streams and videos into short clips ready for Shorts, Reels and TikTok.

apps.name: Phibi
apps.text: A thumbnail editor built for the click: layers, text, effects and quick templates.

apps.name: ForgeLink
apps.text: Ties it all together: move projects, clips and assets between the apps in one click.

featuresSection.title: Built for how creators actually work
featuresSection.subtitle: No subscriptions to five different tools. One launcher, one Steam account, everything updated automatically.

features.title: One hub
features.text: Launch every app, manage projects and see updates from a single place.

features.title: Auto-updates
features.text: New versions roll out automatically, so you're always on the latest build.

features.title: Sign in with Steam
features.text: Your Steam account unlocks everything you own, on any PC.

features.title: Your files stay yours
features.text: Projects and media live on your PC. Nothing is uploaded unless you publish it.

cta.title: Coming soon to Steam
cta.text: The Forge is in development. Wishlist it on Steam to get notified at launch.
